name: Jennifer Racioppi
reason: Too thin once the health rule is applied: her own site (jenniferracioppi.com) frames her work as health coaching (Duke integrative health coach, hormonal health, 'uncompromising health'), and her one book, Cosmic Health, is pitched as an individualised health plan that addresses chronic illness, so it fails the health-claim rule; what remains is a 1:1 astrology session and private coaching (no videos, blog quiet since March 2024), under the ~3-item minimum. No Omega mention on her site.
